plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: The Spotify search-and-add box has moved off the main screen into a popup with a proper Spotify-style look - dark theme, green accents, album art thumbnails on each result, and a rounded search bar - opened via a new "+ Add Tracks" button that appears next to Teacher Playlists whenever you're browsing one. Also fixed a bug where adding a track and then refreshing the currently-open playlist could send the wrong (internal) playlist id to Spotify, the same class of bug fixed for playlist loading in 1.1.6.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
